# Azure Prepare — azd Deployment Planner

💳 Paid Azure subscription required — Curated by Skill Harbor — Microsoft's plan-first preparation skill for Azure Developer CLI (azd) projects: it analyzes your workspace, gathers requirements, selects a recipe (AZD, AZCLI, Bicep or Terraform), then generates `azure.yaml`, infrastructure templates and Dockerfiles — but never before writing a `.azure/deployment-plan.md` skeleton and getting your explicit approval. Routes specialized stacks (Python App Service, AI gateway, cross-cloud migration) to dedicated skills first, hardens security (Entra-only SQL auth, no hardcoded credentials), and hands off to azure-validate before anything deploys. By @microsoft, listed here with credit to its creator. Honest caveats: preparation only — it generates infrastructure code but never runs deployments itself; the mandatory plan-and-approve workflow slows down quick experiments, deliberately, to prevent surprises. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use.
